# RISE Football Agency

> Elite football representation. We scout across Europe and guide Premier League players through their development.

RISE Football Agency represents professional and emerging footballers, working with players, clubs, scouts, coaches, and agents across the European game.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Agency overview and featured stars.
- [Stars](/stars): Players represented by RISE.
- [News](/news): Player news and agency updates.
- [About](/about): Who we are and how we work.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
- [Between The Lines](/between-the-lines): Long-form features and insight.
- [Player Journey](/player-journey): How we develop players.
- [Realise Potential](/realise-potential): Our development philosophy.
